build_optimizer_with_adamw: build an AdamW optimizer with fused kernel and LambdaLR scheduler for a PyTorch model
build_lr_fn_cosine: build a cosine learning rate schedule function with warmup, cycle length, and theta parameters
build_lr_fn_wsd: build a warmup-stable-decay learning rate schedule function with configurable decay fraction and cycle length
create_OptimArgs_dataclass: create an OptimArgs dataclass with configurable lr, weight_decay, beta1, beta2, scheduler, and warmup settings
test_lr_schedulers: test the lr_linear, lr_inv_sqrt, lr_cosine, and lr_wsd learning rate schedule functions at given steps
